title: Neil Degrasse Tyson on being Black, and Women in Science
summary: A short clip of Neil deGrasse Tyson answering a question about why there are not more women in science. He describes the resistance he faced as a Black kid pursuing science and the systemic barriers many people encounter.
why: Linked in diversity-in-tech threads as a personal, thoughtful answer on systemic barriers for minorities and women in science.

quote.text: had a good answer to the silly question "What's with chicks in science?", and the cultural / systemic barriers he had to go through
